mapper.insert: INSERT INTO announcements (title, content, user_id, is_pinned, priority, status, published_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{userId}, #{isPinned}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{publishedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE announcements SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, user_id = #{userId}, is_pinned = #{isPinned}, priority = #{priority}, status = #{status}, published_at = #{publishedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, user_id as userId, is_pinned as isPinned, priority, status, published_at as publishedAt, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM announcements ORDER BY priority DESC, created_at DESC

SELECT id, title, content, user_id as userId, is_pinned as isPinned, priority, status, published_at as publishedAt, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM announcements WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, title, content, user_id as userId, is_pinned as isPinned, priority, status, published_at as publishedAt, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM announcements WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY is_pinned DESC, priority DESC, published_at DESC
